name: io.github.noticedso/cli
description: Use the canonical noticed direct-tool MCP from stdio-only clients.

environmentVariables.name: NOTICED_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Defaults to https://mcp.noticed.so/api/mcp.

environmentVariables.name: NOTICED_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a self-hosted noticed instance. The stdio bridge derives /api/mcp unless NOTICED_MCP_URL is set.
